answer: Farming becomes a walnut bet on surviving 99 epochs of grading, and every ocean settlement recomputes the ripple schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 99 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
